summary: Iteration 14: All 5 reported bug fixes verified successfully. Speedometer now shows 9 readable tick labels (0-160 in 20 increments), VTEC indicator appears when RPM >= 3000, RPM digital readout displays inside tachometer, all 7 MIL warning lights visible at bottom (dimmed at 0.35 opacity when inactive), and needle uses CSS transform:rotate() with 100ms ease-out transition for smooth animation. Edit mode features (independent widget dragging) also verified working.
passed_tests: Speedometer readability: 9 major tick labels found (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120, 140, 160) - properly spaced and readable
VTEC indicator: Red 'VTEC' text visible inside tachometer when RPM >= 3000 [data-testid='vtec-indicator']
RPM digital readout: Numeric RPM value displayed inside tachometer (e.g., '7111', '6823') [data-testid='tach-digital-readout']
MIL Warning lights: All 7 visible at bottom - CHECK ENGINE, OIL PRESSURE, TEMP HIGH, LOW FUEL, SERVICE, BRAKE, ABS - inactive at 0.35 opacity, active at full opacity
Needle smoothness: CSS transition 'transform 100ms ease-out' confirmed on needle line element
Tachometer ticks: 9 labels (0-8) for x1000 r/min scale - readable
Gauge center hub: Both tachometer and speedometer have center hub cap circles
Edit mode - Tachometer drag: Moved 100px left independently, speedometer stayed in place
Edit mode - Warning light drag: LOW FUEL moved 80px up independently, CHECK ENGINE stayed in place

features_verified.details: 9 major ticks: 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120, 140, 160 (max=160). Previously had 18 bunched labels.
Red 'VTEC' text appears inside tachometer gauge face when RPM >= 3000. Uses vtecRange prop {start:3000, end:8000}.
Numeric RPM value displayed inside tachometer via showDigitalValue prop. data-testid='tach-digital-readout'.
All 7 warning lights visible at bottom. Inactive opacity increased from 0.20 to 0.35, inactive color from #3f3f46 to #52525b for better visibility.
Needle uses CSS transform:rotate() with transition:100ms ease-out instead of SVG attribute-based animation.
Both gauges have center hub cap circle at (50,50) with r=3.5.
Tachometer and warning lights can be dragged independently from other widgets.
